sources.title: Wikidata Q160409 (Central Park) and its features: Q532029 Bethesda Terrace and Fountain, Q816268 Belvedere Castle, Q1190219 the Reservoir, Q903865 Great Lawn and Turtle Pond, Q902461 Sheep Meadow, Q3508849 Harlem Meer, Q7757717 The Pond, Q5163141 Conservatory Water, Q5061610 the Mall, Q63337240 North Woods and North Meadow

heightM.note: the folly tower's roof tip above the surrounding park (the rock outcrop and a square tower), proportioned by eye

treeLowM.note: the lower canopy height of the tree masses

treeHighM.note: the upper canopy height of the tree masses (below the folly)

treeSpacingM.note: the spacing of canopy mounds at the finest level at density 1 (each mound a clump of trees)

bethesda.note: Bethesda Terrace and Fountain (Q532029, P625): the generic terrace and fountain, facing up the park toward the lake

terrace.note: the terrace and its fountain plaza: width across the park and depth toward the lake

terraceM.note: the upper terrace above the plaza

fountainM.note: the tiered fountain's height (no figure, LEGAL-1)

belvedere.note: Belvedere Castle (Q816268, P625): the generic folly on its rock

rockM.note: the rock outcrop the folly stands on, above the park

rockRadiusM.note: the outcrop's radius at its foot

keep.note: the folly's half-length and height (its keep)

reservoir.note: the Reservoir's middle, centred across the park and north of the Great Lawn (the Wikidata Q1190219 point, 40.785089, -73.960475, lies near its south-east shore)

reservoirAxes.note: semi-axes along and across the park: an ellipse of about the reservoir's Wikidata area (43 ha, P2046; drawn 92 %), kept between the drives and clear of the Great Lawn

greatLawn.note: Great Lawn and Turtle Pond (Q903865, P625, first point)

greatLawnAxes.note: the Great Lawn's semi-axes along and across the park

turtlePond.note: Turtle Pond, between the Great Lawn and the folly (by eye)

sheepMeadowAxes.note: semi-axes of an ellipse of Sheep Meadow's Wikidata area (15 acres, P2046)

lake.note: the Lake's middle, north of the terrace (no Wikidata point found; by eye)

northMeadow.note: North Meadow, south of the North Woods point (Q63337240), by eye

mallSouth.note: the Mall (Q5061610, P625, second point): its south end; it runs to the terrace

driveInset.note: how far the loop drive runs inside the park outline: from each long side and from each end

lampSpacingM.note: lamps along the drive at the finest level

readabilityScale.note: Structures are drawn twice their real plan and the drive and Mall twice their width so they read in a park 4 km long; lamps three times a lamp head.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.8 (trees, the folly, the terrace); the plan stays the map's park outline (x1.0) so the model fits the green the map draws; structures and paths take the readability scale instead.
